-- A counter written by the agent in the smoke test.
local count = state(wisp.store.get("count") or 0)
local info = wisp.device.info()
local sa = info.safe_area

return ui.screen { align = "center", justify = "center",
  pad = { sa.y1 + 16, info.width - 1 - sa.x2 + 16, info.height - 1 - sa.y2 + 16, sa.x1 + 16 },
  ui.column { gap = 16, align = "center",
    ui.label { ref = "count", text = count, font = 64 },
    ui.button { ref = "inc", text = "+1", on_click = function()
      count:set(count:get() + 1)
      wisp.store.set("count", count:get())
      wisp.log.info("count=" .. count:get())
    end },
  },
}
